posts.name: Aman Kumar
posts.cooked:
grep command is not working correctly, do i need to reinstall it

image619×448 11.4 KB

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
You don’t have install grep. Just use the commands properly. Always remember if there is no output it doesn’t mean that the command is not working, it just means there is nothing to show as the output for that command.

j.s means that find a word that starts with j and there should be any character in between and then the third character should be a s.

posts.name: Aman Kumar
posts.cooked:
But for r.m it should be ‘random’ also matching from line 1 and also ‘runtime’
Similarly with .m it is highlighting ‘om’

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
No r.m will match words like ram
. matches only one character.

r.*m will random. Because this means r and then any number of words but stop at m.
